known_non_bugs: Spotify embed shows 'Application error: a client-side exception has occurred' inside the iframe when rendered in the Playwright/headless Chromium environment. Root cause: Spotify's Next.js embed calls new Intl.Locale() and Playwright's default Chromium context has an empty/invalid locale header, causing RangeError. This is a Playwright-environment-only issue — real end-user browsers (which always ship a valid navigator.language) do NOT hit this. The iframe DOM and src are correct; the fallback 'abrir no spotify' link works. Confirmed as pre-warned in the review request. No action needed for production.
critical_code_review_comments: Music.jsx: minor UX suggestion — the morph label 'lbl-justin' element sits inside the same 14px-tall clip container as 'lbl-raquel'; on very narrow screens the 2-line label may clip. Not a blocker.
PraVoce.jsx: block-10 ('— Lucas!') has GSAP fade-in with scrub — content is empty until user scrolls near it. This is intentional per design (letter animation) — not a bug.

assets.js: BIEBER_GALLERY uses the same s6kznp5v/n4tzx8yp images that also appear in IMAGES.rockInRioSign/rockInRioStage — DRY is fine but if these ever diverge, consider referencing IMAGES.* instead of hardcoding URLs.
No data-testid on the 'footer' element itself (uses <footer> tag) — testable via tag selector but adding data-testid='site-footer' would be more robust.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs are fixed. If Spotify iframe is ever reported as 'Application error' by testing tools, it's a Playwright locale quirk (Intl.Locale RangeError from Spotify's Next.js chunk) — instantiate browser context with locale='pt-BR' or 'en-US' to reproduce a real user experience. Real users on Chrome/Firefox/Safari do not see this. The DOM contract (data-testid, iframe src, fallback link href) is correct and stable.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no unresolved issues. Both original bugs (silent YouTube autoplay iframe + placeholder Music images) are resolved: (a) YouTube iframe replaced with a visible floating Spotify embed (with fallback external link), (b) Music.jsx now consumes IMAGES.raquelHeadphones/justinLive and BIEBER_GALLERY of real Rock in Rio photos.
